title: sisymbrium amphibium subsp. aquaticum
intro: Sisymbrium amphibium subsp. aquaticum, commonly known as water rocket or water rocket mustard, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This aquatic plant is known for its therapeutic properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits of reducing oxidative stress and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of water rocket mustard include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates. The bioactive constituents of Sisymbrium amphibium subsp. aquaticum have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications, including the treatment of cardiovascular diseases and cancer.
